segment.source: Tools that crawl XML sitemaps and record what every URL answers. Start with Sitemaps: every check reads its URLs from a stored snapshot. The status check then looks at one environment, the migration check compares two. The help explains every finding and says who acts on it.
Step 2 — HTTP status and error markers per URL
Review the results of the websitecheck:checksitemap and websitecheck:crawllinks commands: URLs without HTTP 200, TYPO3 error pages and links whose arguments have no effect.
Step 3 — moved URLs without a working redirect

Review the results of the websitecheck:migrationcheck command: does every URL of the reference environment still lead to the same page or record on the target environment — directly or through a redirect?
Step 1 — store the sitemaps every check reads
Review the snapshots of the websitecheck:importsitemaps command: how many URLs every language lists per sitemap group, which sitemap files failed, and a note per snapshot.
What a finding means, and who acts on it
Every verdict, warning and marker of the checks explained: what it means, whether an editor can fix it in the backend or the integrator has to change the configuration, and what to do.
